new_tickets.subject: Production database is down, all customers affected
new_tickets.body: Our main app has been throwing 500 errors for the last 15 minutes. Every customer-facing dashboard is blank. This started right after the 2am deploy.

new_tickets.subject: Can't find the export button
new_tickets.body: I've looked around the settings page for 5 minutes and can't find where to export my report as a CSV. Is it hidden somewhere?

new_tickets.subject: Payment processing failing for all EU customers
new_tickets.body: Since this morning, every checkout attempt from EU-based accounts fails with 'payment declined', even on cards that definitely work. US customers seem fine.

new_tickets.subject: Typo in the welcome email
new_tickets.body: Just noticed the welcome email says 'Wecome' instead of 'Welcome'. Not urgent, just flagging it.

new_tickets.subject: Dashboard loads slowly for large accounts
new_tickets.body: Accounts with 10k+ records take 8-10 seconds to load the dashboard. It's usable but annoying. Been like this for about a week.

new_tickets.subject: Data loss — deleted project didn't restore from backup
new_tickets.body: I accidentally deleted a project and used the 'restore from trash' feature, but it's gone. This project had 3 months of client work in it.

new_tickets.subject: Feature request: dark mode
new_tickets.body: Would love a dark mode option for the app. Not a big deal, just a nice-to-have.

new_tickets.subject: Login works but 2FA codes never arrive
new_tickets.body: I can enter my password fine but the SMS 2FA code never shows up. Tried 3 times over 20 minutes. I'm locked out of my account.

resolved_notes.subject: Checkout failing for European cards
resolved_notes.body: EU payment gateway had an expired SSL cert causing declines region-wide.
resolved_notes.resolution: Renewed the gateway's SSL certificate and rotated the payment provider API key. Fixed within 40 minutes, all EU transactions confirmed working after redeploy.

resolved_notes.subject: Slow dashboard for large accounts
resolved_notes.body: Accounts with many records experienced multi-second load times.
resolved_notes.resolution: Added pagination and an index on the records table. Load time dropped from 9s to under 1s.

resolved_notes.subject: Minor copy typo in onboarding flow
resolved_notes.body: A typo was found in step 2 of onboarding.
resolved_notes.resolution: Fixed the copy in the next release cycle, no rush needed.

resolved_notes.subject: 2FA SMS codes delayed or missing
resolved_notes.body: Users reported SMS 2FA codes not arriving, locking them out.
resolved_notes.resolution: SMS provider had a delivery outage in one region. Switched to backup provider and notified affected users. Restored full access within 2 hours.
